baselines.random: uniform random over select/confirm/press/release/wait/inspect and the visible ids
baselines.expert: scripted expert reading the station's step list (privileged: sees target ids) — an upper bound, not a learner
baselines.retrieval: word-overlap retrieval (IDF-weighted) over the step's title, cue and sourced why text; inspects before touching; hint only when nothing matches. No language model.
baselines.retrieval-ask: the same retrieval heuristic, also asking for a hint whenever the runner-up is within 1.5 of the best match
